title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover free social spaces and activities at the College of the Holy Cross, from art galleries and historic libraries to outdoor trails and campus traditions.

cards.entity_name: Iris and B. Gerald Cantor Art Gallery
cards.title: View Contemporary Art
cards.subtitle: Prior Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Explore rotating exhibitions of contemporary and historical art. Admission is free and open to the public during gallery hours.
cards.short_summary: A free campus art gallery featuring diverse rotating exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Cantor Art Gallery | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; check website for current installation closures.

cards.title: Study in the Main Stacks
cards.subtitle: Central Campus
cards.notes: Utilize the main library's extensive collections and quiet study spaces. Public access is available for general use during most operating hours.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus library offering free research and study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Our libraries are open to the public for general use (including in-house use of the collection, research databases, etc.) so long as library rules are honored.
cards.source_title: Who can use the Holy Cross libraries? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Public access restricted during the last two hours of operation; students have priority for computers.

cards.title: Visit the Spiritual Heart
cards.subtitle: Linden Lane
cards.notes: Enter this historic 1924 chapel for quiet reflection or to attend free musical performances like the Chapel Artist Series.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus chapel open for reflection and free concerts.
cards.evidence_claim: Welcoming visitors from every faith and background to reflect, pray, or simply sit in peaceful silence.
cards.source_title: St. Joseph Memorial Chapel | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open daily for visitors; check schedule for specific Mass or concert times.

cards.entity_name: Joanne Chouinard-Luth Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.title: Run the Indoor Track
cards.subtitle: Upper Campus
cards.notes: Current students can access the suspended jogging track and fitness equipment at 'The Jo' without additional fees.
cards.short_summary: A student wellness hub featuring a free indoor running track.
cards.evidence_claim: Facilities are accessible to current students, employees and emeriti faculty... Prior to arrival, everyone must sign a one-time, annual Facility Use Waiver.
cards.source_title: Fitness & Recreation | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Restricted to current students and employees with a valid ID and signed waiver.

cards.title: Attend Outdoor Screenings
cards.subtitle: Prior Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Join the community for free outdoor film screenings and performances at this open-air venue behind the Prior Center.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor amphitheatre hosting free films and community events.
cards.evidence_claim: OUTDOOR FILM SCREENING - Patterson Amphitheatre at The Prior... Admission is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open-air venue; events are typically seasonal and weather-dependent.

cards.title: Relax in the Living Room
cards.subtitle: Near Dinand Library
cards.notes: Visit the home of the College's chaplains for free snacks, coffee, and a quiet place to study or socialize in a cozy environment.
cards.short_summary: A welcoming campus house offering free snacks and social space.
cards.evidence_claim: Campion House invites everyone in for more than just a cup of coffee or a snack—it's a space where you'll find a listening ear.
cards.source_title: Facilities & Spaces | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; known for 'Wednesday bagels' and a welcoming atmosphere.

cards.title: Join a Pep Rally
cards.subtitle: Kimball Hall Exterior
cards.notes: Participate in free campus-wide events like cheerleader pep rallies and student organization fairs held on the central lawn.
cards.short_summary: A central campus lawn hosting free student rallies and fairs.
cards.evidence_claim: Cheerleader Pep Rally Kimball Quad, 7 - 8 p.m. ... These are just the first of many campus activities and events.
cards.source_title: Welcome Back Events - Holy Cross Magazine
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor space; events are typically free for the campus community.

cards.title: Attend Student Performances
cards.subtitle: Hogan Level 3
cards.notes: Catch free performances by student groups, including a cappella concerts and cultural showcases, frequently hosted in the ballroom.
cards.short_summary: A large campus venue for free student-led performances.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hogan Ballroom is full of student leaders... Watch out for upcoming programs and events from over 100+ organizations.
cards.source_title: Holy Cross Office of Student Involvement | Facebook
cards.access_notes: Access typically requires a student ID for indoor events; check myHC for event listings.

cards.title: Walk the Hillside Trails
cards.subtitle: Campus Perimeter
cards.notes: Explore the wooded trails surrounding the upper campus for a free nature walk with views of the Worcester skyline.
cards.short_summary: Free walking trails offering nature access on the campus perimeter.
cards.evidence_claim: Walk one of the several trails around campus... Beautiful green space and a landscaped path for outdoor rec opportunities.
cards.source_title: Fitness & Recreation | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; trails are accessible from various points on the upper campus.

cards.title: Cheer at Home Games
cards.subtitle: Lower Campus
cards.notes: Holy Cross students can attend all regular season home athletic events, including football and baseball games, for free with their ID.
cards.short_summary: Free admission for students to regular season home sports games.
cards.evidence_claim: As a student, attending all regular season home sporting events is free!
cards.source_title: Athletics | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Free for students with valid Holy Cross ID; public tickets require purchase.
